newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hysan to give Singapore project profit as dividend.
newsitem.headline: Hysan to give Singapore project profit as dividend.

text.p: Hysan Development Co Ltd said on Wednesday it will distribute the profit generated from the sale of a Singapore residential project to shareholders as a dividend.
"Profit generated from this development will be distributed to the shareholders as dividend after the tax clearance in Singapore is obtained," the property investor said in a statement.
It has a 10 percent stake in the Melville Park project. Hysan said the 1,232 units in the project were sold and delivered to buyers but it did not disclose the size of profit generated.
Analysts said the profit was relatively small, amounting to tens of millions of Hong Kong dollars.
Hysan posted net profit of HK$1.35 billion in calendar 1996, up 10.12 percent from the previous year.
It also proposed to pay a final dividend of HK$0.72, lifting the total dividend for 1996 to HK$1.12 against HK$1.05 in 1995.
The profit from the Singapore project was expected to be booked in 1997, analysts said.
